svg.title: AWS delivery and model lifecycle
svg.desc: AWS delivery and model lifecycle with expanded prepare, tune, train, SNS approval, and evaluate/publish states. The companion state-to-task diagram provides the exact ECS invocation and Choice-state mapping.

g.text: Development profile: ECS training + ECS-hosted MLflow; Lambda scoring
ECS platform VPC - two public subnets; controlled security groups
Fargate runTask.sync; training image supplied by ECR
Solid arrows: delivery, orchestration, and artifacts. Approval is performed by a person.
Official AWS Architecture Icons, July 2026. Source: extended CloudFormation and deployment automation.
